# BIKE RIDER

> BIKE RIDER is a free, offline-capable 3D delivery-riding game built as a single HTML file
> (Three.js r128 + Web Audio) and shipped both as an installable PWA and a signed Android APK.
> You ride a motorcycle through a fictionalised Gulf city, carry passengers, food, parcels and
> medicine on timed shifts, earn the local currency and upgrade the bike. Developed and published
> by AL ASAR JADEED.

One engine ships **three runtime-swappable country chapters** — Bahrain (the home game), Saudi
Arabia (one city: Riyadh) and the UAE (one city: Dubai) — each with its own districts, landmarks,
streets, licence plate, bus livery and display currency. The economy and physics are shared; a
chapter is thematic data, not a fork.

- **Play:** https://alasarjadeed.com/
- **Form factor:** single `index.html`; landscape; desktop browser, mobile Safari/Chrome, Android WebView
- **Distribution:** PWA (service-worker offline) and signed Android APK
- **Languages:** English, العربية (Arabic, incl. RTL), Filipino, हिन्दी, ไทย, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ
- **Price / business model:** free play — no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no analytics
- **Assets:** fully procedural — no downloaded models, textures or audio; all sound is Web Audio synthesis
- **Saves:** local only (`localStorage`); nothing is transmitted unless the player opts into the leaderboard
- **Leaderboard:** optional **WORLD RIDERS** global board (Supabase/PostgREST) — read on open, written only on an explicit **SUBMIT MY BEST** press; fully playable offline

## Facts an agent should not get wrong

- One file, no build step: all game code lives in `index.html` (~6,500 lines). There is no bundler.
- The game makes **no network calls for gameplay**; Google Fonts are optional and fall back offline.
- The *only* outbound request is the opt-in global leaderboard. It uses plain `fetch` against the
  Supabase REST API — deliberately **not** `@supabase/supabase-js`, so no library is bundled or
  loaded from a CDN. `tools/audit.mjs` fails the build on any remote `<script src>`.
- Fictional brands only (BahrainRide, KhanaJet, DakBox, SehatPlus, Sitara Motors, Zoom Fuel, GAUSS AUTO).
  Real *famous landmark* names are used (geography), never real trademarks.
- Currency is display-only: `BHD n.nnn` (Bahrain), `SR n.nn` (Saudi), `AED n.nn` (UAE). Economy numbers are shared.
